general_information.Syllabus Name: Academic Listening and Speaking - Nghe Nói học thuật

general_information.Pre-Requisite: Passed ENS311/ ENS321/TRS401/ENT303 or equivalent subjects
general_information.Description: This module aims at improving students' listening comprehension and speaking skills. Listening to class lectures and practice of note taking benefit studens in enhancing listening skills. In addition, discussion and presentation tasks offer students opportunities to practice speaking and improve their presentation skills. Assessment Scheme: 1) Ongoing assessment: Student gets 0.25 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE+ Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: FE>=4 and FR>=5.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Know how and use note-taking techniques in listening to lectures
Construct and deliver effective speeches and presentations
Participate and perform well in group discussions
Practice acquired skills and techniques to make a presentation on an academic topic

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Knowledge and skills acquired from the spec
assessments.Grading Guide: Week 13: + Offline - In class: Students are required to listen to a lecture (around 5-8 minutes in length) for 2 times. Students take notes of the lecture outline and ideas. + Offline - At home: Prepare a presentation/lecture on the topic they have listened to. Students are encouraged to do further research to support their presentations. Week 14 - In class: Students deliver a presentation/ lecture that they have prepared. Time limit: 6-8 minutes/presentation.
assessments.Note: Teacher can ask students to work either individually or in groups.
